summary: T. Rowe Price OHA Select Private Credit Fund filed a routine Form 8-K reporting September 2026 regular distributions and monthly operating metrics. The board declared $0.2000 per share gross for Class I, S, and D shares, netting $0.2000, $0.1815, and $0.1946 after servicing fees, payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record September 30, 2026, with reinvestment available. August 31, 2026 NAV was $26.07 per share on $1,619.6 million aggregate NAV, $3,129.2 million portfolio fair value, and $1,602.7 million debt, a 0.99x debt-to-equity ratio. The continuous offering of up to $2.5 billion remains ongoing, with $1,344.8 million, $126.9 million, and $175.1 million raised across Classes I, S, and D. No special-situation event occurred.
